verdict.rationale: Munito AI documents a drop-in migration path from the OpenAI SDK. You change the base URL, the key and the model ID. It supports the OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses APIs, and its llms.txt probe lists OpenAI base URLs. Missing for 10: the docs also require changing the model ID (not only the base URL and key), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that an unmodified OpenAI SDK client works end to end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Move from the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK. Change the base URL, the key and the model ID.
Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs
through the OpenAI-compatible or the Anthropic-compatible API
Send your key in `Authorization: Bearer` or `X-API-Key`.
